name: GXO Logistics Distribution Center - Fort Worth TX (Everman)

fieldNotes.site: GXO leases the 644,318 SF 'Building Two' of the Everman Crossroads campus (developer MDH Partners) on a ~31.5-acre site at 1401 Everman Pkwy. Pin lands on this southern bulk distribution building; address and lease confirmed via GlobeSt / REBusinessOnline / Realgraph. 40-ft clear height, 241 car spaces.
fieldNotes.truckGate: No barrier arm, sliding/swing gate, or guard booth at any driveway. Driveways from Everman Pkwy and the campus interior drive are wide and fully open. Modern speculative Class-A bulk building with no perimeter security gate.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No booth structure observed at any entrance.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Cross-dock building: continuous dock-door banks on the south face (confirmed by Street View dock doors with levelers and bumpers) and the north face, plus a partial bank on the west face. Estimated ~110 doors total; band 50+.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Marked trailer-parking stalls in the truck court between this building and the campus's other building; multiple trailers observed parked without tractors. Band 25-50.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated trailer-storage stalls present in the north truck court — counts as a drop yard.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock banks on opposite (north and south) building faces — shipping and receiving can run from physically separate clusters.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Wide internal truck courts on north and south provide ample paved holding space inside the property before docks.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Multiple wide open driveways and generous paved aprons — physical room exists to add a bypass/express lane if a gate were installed.
fieldNotes.truckGateCount: Multiple open driveway access points off Everman Pkwy serve the truck courts; counted ~2 primary truck-usable accesses.
fieldNotes.trailerParkingCapacity: Honest estimate from overhead imagery of the truck-court stall striping; low confidence.
